Those named Suchita are believed to be endowed with the gift of knowledge and wisdom, making them valuable contributors to society and seekers of truth. In Hindu mythology, Suchita is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, arts, and learning.

Suchita is also the name of a legendary queen of the Vatsa kingdom, who was known for her wisdom, beauty, and strength. She is often cited as an exemplar of a virtuous queen in Indian literature and folklore.
